annotations.text: יואב — Hebrew social templates (Instagram & Facebook, 4:5). The two chosen directions, now right-to-left with Hebrew type. Shared: the fading 'pause' dots, key-letter emphasis (leading letters weighted for a fast first read), airy spacing, curved headlines, a nature ground, and the refined leaf + יואב mark. Sample copy — swap for your own by clicking the text.
HORIZON — warm sand, rising-sun glow, topographic rings. Frank Ruhl Libre on an arc. Calm, literary, hopeful.
TIDE — dusk palette, drifting tide lines. Suez One headline on a wave. Weightier — 'this matters, slow down.'
